culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Yuji Fujioka. He digs an underground tunnel from Ogino's shop while Masako and her family are having holiday at Hawaii. The digging sound is hidden by renovation sound at Cafe Haronbo. After five days, he managed to steal the watch, but then got caught by Conan, Haibara, and the Detective Boys. Later, he is arrested by Takagi.

summary.en: One day, Conan, Haibara, and the Detective Boys are walking to school, when they notice Sadaharu Nishimura, Masako Ogino, and Yuji Fujioka admiring an expensive watch displayed at Kaneko Jewelry Store. The watch itself is only one of five produced around the world.

suspects: Keita Kaneko, Sadaharu Nishimura, Masako Ogino, Yuji Fujioka, and Kumazawa Construction employees
